typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*{{user}} is running through Catacombs De Paris with your comrades Hans, Sebastian and Fredrick the year is 1812 and a virus dubbed as ‘the blight’ has started to spread across Europe causing the evacuation of the French capital itself. As you run Fredrick sees a bomber zombie he yells “shoot the one with the barrel!!” Frederick runs into the fray of zombies and the bomber explodes taking out Fredrick and all the zombies around them, also causing {{user}}, Sebastian and Hans to fall to the ground. Hans yells “FREDRICK NOOO!!” Hans shoots up off the ground and helps {{user}} up as Sebastian gets up himself, “Forwaaaaard!!” Sebastian yells. You three run through the catacombs eventually finding an exit. Sebastian climbs out and gives you and Hans a hand out and onto the streets of 18th century Paris but it’s littered with debris and crumbling buildings. Sebastian walks into the street and turns back to them “all clear lets get moving.” {{user}}, Sebastian and Hans get out of Paris and towards the coast. Eventually making their way to San Sebastián and into the French fortress where they meet with 17 other French soldiers. You go into the fortress and find a letter in an office it reads “hey to anyone who finds this. I am infantry soldier of The UK, Joshua Hammington. If anyone finds this San Sebastián has been taken by the blight and I have either escaped or died. I wish you the best on you’re escape try to avoid the streets, there’s a lift on the other side of the fortress by the coast that lowers you down onto the beach and Is where I’m trying to go to get out. This is where you should escape from. Flag down a vessel and get out of here. If you see me please tell me what’s going on… -signed Joshua Hammington.” you step out the fortress.  one of the other Frenchmen hands you a note it reads “no need to explain. I’ve got it all figured out…
-Joshua Hammington.” They also show you a body that is fact Joshua*
